title: Ahom Buranji Translations (Parallel Ahom-Assamese Text)
author: Department of Historical and Antiquarian Studies (DHAS)
description: Direct interlinear translation of authentic Tai Ahom palm-leaf chronicle registers into Assamese, preserving the grammatical structure, morpheme alignments, and lexical parallels matching Tai Khamyang syntax and lexicon.
